name: Digital Tax Map — TAX_LOT_POLYGON display outlines

authentication.evidence: Anonymous exact-BBL requests captured 2026-09-26; services/api/tests/fixtures/dtm_lot_outline/MANIFEST.json records exact URLs, response hashes and timestamps.

rate_limits.notes: No numeric request-rate limit established. Published maxRecordCount is 1000; this connector requests at most two records for one BBL. One request per lookup, no paging or automatic retry; HTTP 429 is a typed upstream error and never a no-outline result.

update_frequency: Unresolved: catalog cadence statements conflict (Daily/Weekly metadata versus monthly extraction description). The DAILY service name does not establish a refresh guarantee. Layer dataLastEditDate 1790410012940 (2026-09-26T08:06:52.940Z) was observed at capture; it is an edit timestamp, not a release version.
geographic_coverage: All five boroughs; individual DOF tax-lot polygons. This is a tax-map display layer, not a zoning-lot or development-rights source. For the Wallabout condo case the live service returned distinct exact polygons for 3022640032 and 3022640033, and no feature for billing 3022647515; no historical or retired-lot endpoint was used.

fields_available.note: Bounded fields verified against recorded layer metadata. Source spatial reference 102100/latestWkid 3857; query explicitly requests server reprojection to EPSG:4326 via outSR=4326 and GeoJSON. Coordinates are transported unchanged, never used for measurement.
fields_available.identity_validation: BBL and BORO/BLOCK/LOT must all exactly match the canonical requested BBL, including verified field types. Missing, conflicting or coerced identifiers fail closed. CONDO_FLAG=C is preserved as a source attribute, never interpreted as a condo-unit polygon, billing complex outline, or legal site definition.
fields_available.version_semantics: No dataset release field is exposed; dataset_version is null. EFFECTIVE_TAX_YEAR is preserved in source notes, never relabeled as release version, current status, or freshness.

terms_usage_notes: DOF Digital Tax Map information may not reflect the latest changes in other City systems and is provided for informational purposes. Not a boundary survey or zoning-lot determination. No numerical positional tolerance is established here; the MapPLUTO plus-or-minus 20 ft statement is not attributed to this source.
connector_implementation: services/api/app/connectors/dtm_lot_outline.py. Explicit GET /api/v1/properties/{bbl}/lot-geometry?source=tax-map; default MapPLUTO path and authoritative EPSG:2263 measurement path unchanged. Fixed host, exact canonical-BBL equality, fixed field list, record cap 2, returnGeometry=true, f=geojson and outSR=4326; timeout 20 seconds, response ceiling 2 MiB. No bulk import, joins, union, spatial calculations or repair. Four typed outcomes: single_lot, no_outline, multiple_features requiring review, invalid_geometry. Wrong CRS, identity mismatch, malformed/truncated collection and service faults fail closed.
contract: Additive lot_geometry 1.1.0 admits this source ID; old 1.0.0 MapPLUTO payloads remain valid. Canonical schema, generated TypeScript and runtime bundle are synchronized.
last_successful_ingestion: 2026-09-26 fixture capture only; this connector is request-driven and does not ingest citywide data.
health_status: Verified live fixture capture on 2026-09-26, exact timestamps in manifest; not a promise of current service health.
known_limitations: Tax-map geometry is approximate and does not establish a legal boundary or a zoning lot.
A current service response is not proof that every parcel/legal record is current; resolve source conflicts through qualified review.
The two-base-lot association still comes from the separate condo records resolver, not geometry or visual adjacency.
More than one feature for a requested BBL withholds all geometry and requires review; no first-feature pick or fabricated split.
Display ring validation checks finite in-range closed rings only; it does not certify topology, survey accuracy, buildability or legal merge eligibility.
Dataset release version and refresh SLA are unknown.
fallback_source: No automatic source failover. The separately requested MapPLUTO condo billing outline remains context only when all individual outlines are unavailable.
open_questions: Reconcile conflicting catalog refresh-cadence statements before asserting a freshness SLA.
Obtain an official source-specific numeric accuracy statement before assigning any tolerance.
